title: Data quality matters more than model size
body: A smaller model on a clean bird corpus outperforms a larger one on duplicated, PII-laden notes.

title: Cleaning must be reproducible
body: Manifests, hashes, and versioned shards turn corpus work into engineering — not a one-off notebook.

title: Metadata is essential
body: Language, confidence, habitat, and season tags unlock filtering and multimodal alignment later.

title: Domain-specific preprocessing improves downstream AI
body: Taxonomy, call normalization, and GPS masking are not optional extras for bird intelligence.

title: Community datasets require trust engineering
body: Observers share generously; the corpus pipeline must repay that with privacy and conservation care.
